data_description.host: IP address or hostname — no http(s):// prefix, no port suffix (e.g. 192.168.1.100 or mynas.local)
data_description.port: e.g. 80 for HTTP, 443 (or a custom port) when SSL is enabled
data_description.ssl: Enable if your OMV web interface is reachable via HTTPS
data_description.verify_ssl: Disable only when using a self-signed certificate

totp.title: Two-factor authentication
totp.description: Sign in with either a one-time verification code or your TOTP secret. A code is valid for this login only — after a Home Assistant restart or session expiry you will need to reauthenticate. The secret is stored and lets the integration sign in again automatically.

data_description.code: 6-digit one-time code from your authenticator app. Requires reauthentication after a Home Assistant restart or session expiry.
data_description.totp_secret: Base32 secret from your authenticator setup — enables automatic re-logins, no reauthentication after restarts. Leave the code field empty when using this.

error.invalid_totp_secret: Invalid TOTP secret or the generated code was rejected
error.totp_code_or_secret_required: Enter either a verification code or the TOTP secret (exactly one)

abort.already_configured: This OpenMediaVault host is already configured. Use Reconfigure to update its host, port, SSL or two-factor authentication settings instead of adding it again.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: This account belongs to a different OpenMediaVault host than the one being reconfigured or reauthenticated.

data_description.reboot_repair_disabled: When enabled, the Home Assistant repair notification for a pending OMV reboot is suppressed. Useful when a reboot cannot be performed immediately, e.g. because VMs are running on the NAS.
data_description.update_tracking_disabled: When enabled, no Home Assistant update entity is created for OMV package updates. The 'Available package updates' sensor keeps reporting the pending count regardless.
data_description.smart_interval: How often SMART data (status, attributes, disk temperature) is read. Reading SMART wakes disks from standby, so a larger value lets disks spin down for power saving. Defaults to the scan interval.
data_description.smart_polling_disabled: When enabled, SMART is never polled. Disks are never woken by this integration, but SMART status, SMART attributes and disk temperature entities become unavailable.
data_description.max_consecutive_failures: How many consecutive failed polls to bridge with cached data before entities become unavailable. Set high to restore the previous unbounded behavior.
data_description.selected_cron_jobs: Creates a button for each selected user-defined cron job. Warning: pressing such a button runs the job's arbitrary shell command on the NAS. Default: none.
